activities.anchor: The founding cases set the template
activities.caption: scrub the dates that built the lesion map
activities.name: neuroLesionTimeline

events.title: Phineas Gage's injury
events.text: An iron rod through the left frontal lobe; survival and a reported personality transformation — the entry case for frontal function.

events.title: Broca's patient 'Tan'
events.text: Understood language, produced almost none; autopsy revealed a left inferior frontal lesion — 'we speak with the left hemisphere.'

events.title: Wernicke's mirror case
events.text: Fluent, rapid, largely meaningless speech with comprehension devastated; lesion in the left superior temporal region.

events.title: The Iowa Gambling Task
events.text: Bechara and colleagues formalise the ventromedial prefrontal deficit: patients keep drawing from bad decks, their anticipatory gut responses absent.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — a lesion-method briefing
activities.name: neuroInferSpot

config.prompt: One line of this lesion-method briefing is wrong — click it:
lines: Every lesion is a natural experiment — size, cause and chronicity are never controlled.
The brain reorganises after injury, so chronic deficits understate the acute contribution.
If damaging region R abolishes function X, then R computes X — the region is where the work happens.
Connectome-style lesion modelling tests which regions' disconnection best predicts which deficits.
config.correction: R may be a necessary cable in a network that computes X elsewhere — lesions are perturbations within networks, not map-pins on phrenological charts.
config.why: The exact opposite of the 19th-century faculty psychology Broca's era is often confused with.

activities.anchor: choosing from decks that are advantageous in the long run
activities.caption: pair each instrument with what it measures
activities.name: neuroFrontalMatch

config.prompt: Pair each instrument or idea with what it measures or claims:

pairs.right: long-run advantageous decks versus lucrative bad ones — and vmPFC patients keep drawing from the bad ones
affect carries the load in value-based choice; strip the tags and deciding collapses into endless analysis
perseveration on a rule that has silently changed is the frontal signature
the executive systems that tested intelligence was never designed to touch

config.why: The clinical dissociation — tested intelligence intact, everyday judgement destroyed — is why executive assessment exists at all.

activities.anchor: Clinical practice runs on standardised batteries
activities.caption: walk the capacity referral, step by step
activities.name: neuroCapacityBranch

config.root: A family asks whether their grandfather can still manage his own finances. You are the clinician the referral lands on.

start.text: The referral question is capacity. What kind of determination is this?

choices.label: A medical diagnosis that settles the question
choices.feedback: A capacity finding is not a diagnosis — it is a legal determination informed by neuropsychological evidence.

choices.label: A legal determination informed by psychological evidence
choices.feedback: The right frame: the evidence informs the law, and the four functions decide.

diagnose.text: The frame was wrong — how does the referral actually work?

choices.label: Assess whether he can understand, retain, weigh and communicate a decision
choices.feedback: That four-function test is the capacity evaluation, feeding a legal determination.

choices.label: Hand the family a leaflet and close the case
choices.feedback: The assessment still has to happen — the finding can remove a legal right.

assess.text: Testing shows he understands and communicates well but cannot weigh the options against each other. What follows?

choices.label: Capacity is all-or-nothing, so every right falls at once
choices.feedback: Capacity is decision-specific — losing it for finances does not remove it elsewhere.

choices.label: Report a decision-specific finding: unable to weigh this decision
choices.feedback: The profile, not a verdict, is what the court needs.

report.text: The written report states the four-function profile with its error structure — validity, cultural fairness and the assessor's own bias are directly consequential, because this finding can remove a person's legal right to decide where they live or how their money is spent.

config.why: Capacity evaluation — understand, retain, weigh, communicate — is a legal determination informed by neuropsychological evidence; professional standards exist because this subfield's numbers change lives.

config.prompt: In roughly what share of right-handers is language left-lateralised?
config.why: About 95% — real but modest hemispheric specialisation, with the right hemisphere stronger for spatial attention and prosody. The pop version fails every test of measurement: both hemispheres collaborate on essentially every real task.
config.context: 'We use 10% of our brains' dies the same way: lesions anywhere cause deficits — the field's founding observation refutes it directly.

activities.anchor: The adult brain's recovery capacities are real and bounded
activities.caption: order the recovery arc
activities.name: neuroRehabOrder

config.prompt: Stroke recovery and constraint-induced therapy — order the sequence:
items: Stroke: spontaneous recovery is steepest in the first weeks to months
Deficits plateau — therapy exploits the mechanism rather than waiting for it
The unaffected arm is restrained for most waking hours, forcing intensive use of the paretic one
Cortical representation of the affected limb measurably expands — reorganisation, not regeneration
The limits stand: severed CNS axons essentially do not regenerate, and plasticity can be maladaptive
config.why: The EXCITE trial showed functional improvement roughly double usual care — rehabilitation is applied plasticity, dose-dependent and expensive, which is why access, not biology, is often the binding constraint.

activities.anchor: Language breakdown is the discipline's classic territory
activities.caption: drag the divider — fluent versus non-fluent
activities.name: neuroAphasiaCompare

config.prompt: The two classical aphasias, side by side — drag the divider.

before.label: Broca's (non-fluent)
before.text: Telegraphic, effortful output with largely preserved comprehension — production and syntax damaged, and the patient knows exactly what they cannot say.

after.label: Wernicke's (fluent)
after.text: Fluent, prosodic, empty or neologistic speech with poor comprehension — and the patient is characteristically unaware of the problem.

config.why: The founding double dissociation, met at the bedside. Conduction aphasia adds the disconnection story — comprehension and production preserved, repetition devastated — and alexia without agraphia remains the purest demonstration that reading is not one faculty.

activities.anchor: The amnesias refine the multiple-systems doctrine
activities.caption: file the amnesias by pattern
activities.name: neuroAmnesiaBuckets

config.prompt: File each amnesia by its pattern:
buckets: medial temporal — formation fails, skills spare

items.label: H.M.'s pattern: working memory and procedural learning spared
Korsakoff's syndrome, from thiamine deficiency in alcoholism
hours-long anterograde failure resolving without trace
loss without structural lesion, often around psychological trauma
new declarative filing fails while procedural learning runs on

config.why: Each pattern is a natural double dissociation executed by disease — and the diagnosis predicts prognosis, rehabilitation approach and, in Korsakoff's case, preventability.
